Eligibility Criteria
Users who completed an application for an Aptos Incentivized Testnet (AIT 1, 2, or 3) are eligible to receive
300 APT tokens
.
Users who minted an
APTOS:ZERO testnet NFT
(the original minter, not the current owner) are eligible to receive
150 APT tokens
.
Users with over
20 connected wallets
or
IP addresses shared with more than 20 other accounts
are
not eligible
.
Users from sanctioned countries/territories, including
Cuba, North Korea, Crimea, Donetsk, Luhansk, Iran, and Syria
, are
not eligible
.
Aptos Foundation and Labs employees and their families
are
not eligible
.

[email protected]
